thread:
maria: FYI — AcmeCorp reported a 403 when one of their devs tries to open the project in the Console. They say the user is in Okta group `acme-widget-admins` but the Console shows: "Permission denied (403)". API access with the user's service key still works for inference. Repro steps they gave: 1) SSO login -> 2) switch org to AcmeCorp -> 3) click project `widget-service` -> 403. SCIM log mentions a failed sync the other night (500). Customer is on Dedicated. I can share logs if needed.

raj: Can you paste the exact HTTP response you see in the Console network tab or screenshot of the UI error? Also need org_id + user email so I can cross-check the account mapping.

maria: Pasting sanitized network response here: ```json
{
  "status":403,
  "error":"permission_denied",
  "message":"user lacks role for project access"
}
```
Org: org_0xACME, user: sarah@acme.example. SCIM job: last run 2024-05-05T03:12:18Z -> returned 500. They re-used the same group name but recently renamed in Okta then renamed back.

support-bot: Ticket created (#SUP-98765) and linked to this thread. Notifying oncall. :white_check_mark:

lee-csm: Customer is worried — they have a production rollout tomorrow. Can we get a workaround asap? They prefer not to remove/reinvite users if avoidable.

raj: Quick checks I'll run: 1) confirm SCIM mapping table for `acme-widget-admins` -> project role, 2) check last successful SCIM delta for that user, 3) verify id_token claims when user logs in (does the id_token contain `groups` or an `okta:groups` claim?). Maria: can you confirm whether the app is using group-to-role mapping or SCIM group provisioning?

maria: They confirmed provisioning -> group-to-role via SCIM. Okta change was a rename then a rollback which may have left an orphaned group object in our SCIM cache.

oncall-dan: I just pulled service logs — the SCIM sync runner hit a template parsing error at 03:12 causing a 500. That job touched group links and aborted before clean up. There is a stale mapping entry: `group_id=00g123-orphan` referencing okta display name `acme-widget-admins`. The mapping service still has `group_id` != current Okta id.

raj: Good find. Short-term workaround: manually bind the user to the project with role `project-admin` via Org admin UI so they can proceed with their rollout. Long-term: we should re-run a full SCIM reconciliation for org_0xACME and remove orphaned group entries. Maria, do you have permission to apply the manual binding? If not, CSM/ops can.

maria: I don't have org-admin rights for that customer. CSM asked me to avoid direct changes; we can present the manual bind as a recommended step.

lee-csm: I'll ask Acme to accept a short-lived manual grant while infra re-runs reconciliation. They OK'd a temporary binding by their security lead.

raj: Steps I'll take now: 1) escalate to infra to re-run SCIM reconciliation for org_0xACME (full sync, not delta), 2) clear orphan mapping `00g123-orphan`, 3) confirm id_token group claim is present after fixes, 4) once reconciled, remove temporary manual grant and validate role inheritance. ETA for first pass: 2 hours.

oncall-dan: Kicking off full reconciliation now. Noting in logs: reconciliation lock acquired by job scim-reconciler-21. I'll monitor and post status.

maria: I notified the customer and gave the manual-binding option. They're going to provide a brief window for us to perform the reconcile. Thank you.

raj: After reconciliation completes, we should run this quick check with the customer: 1) user login -> open devtools -> inspect id_token in network response (token endpoint) -> ensure `groups` claim lists `acme-widget-admins`; 2) refresh Console, verify project list appears. If still failing, we'll collect `x-request-id` from Console network call and escalate to platform-auth.

oncall-dan: Reconcile finished — no further 500s. Orphan mapping cleared. I can see SCIM events: user sarah@acme.example now provisioned under group id `00g789-current`.

maria: Customer confirms they can see the project now and the 403 is gone. They left this note: "Thanks, that fixed it — we had a weird Okta rename+rollback." :tada:

raj: I'll close SUP-98765 after verifying no residual mappings. Action items: infra: add guard to SCIM delta path to avoid aborting on template parse error; infra + platform-auth to add a short diagnostic to surface `group_id` mismatch in org settings UI.

lee-csm: I'll follow up with Acme about post-mortem and timeline for permanent fix.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-98765 marked as resolved by raj at 1715010432.
